attributes.context: This text appears in Section 8 - Wages, under Establishment of Rates, and is tied to the process for setting wage rates for new or significantly changed jobs, including advance information about new equipment installation or modification of existing equipment.

extraction_text: Whenever new jobs are created or significant changes are introduced involving established jobs, the Company will, to the best of its ability, provide the Union with 90 days' advance information, including such items as anticipated duties, shift schedules, rates of pay, start-up procedures, new equipment installation or significant modification of existing equipment, etc.

attributes.context: This text appears under SECTION 17 - RATE RETENTION and follows provisions for the Kraft Division's operating schedules and holiday pay. It establishes red-circle rate protections for employees displaced by company-initiated changes, including labor-saving equipment or machinery, subject to line-of-progression limitations.

extraction_text: General: The purpose of this section of the Labor Agreement is to provide for a red-circle rate when the Company: A. Institutes labor-saving equipment or machinery, B. Abandons an entire department or a job classification, C. Institutes revised production methods or job procedures, which permanently eliminates the job, combines it with another job, or permanently reduces the number of employees in the job and results in the employee being permanently reassigned to a lower job rate. Any employees displaced but who were not in the line of progression affected by the change shall not be entitled to a red-circle rate. Day off relief employees who spend more than 50% of their time in the affected line of progression will be given a red-circle rate.
